newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as technical resistance met.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as technical resistance met.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower as the November contract early and quietly bumped into technical resistance near the $10.00 per cwt level then backed down, traders said.
"The market rallied into resistance and failed," a trader said. Also "the continuation of declines in International prices" weighed on futures.
Rice closed 0.02 to 0.08 cent per cwt lower, with November down 0.04 at $9.94 per cwt.
